activity.notes: Aguinaldo was elected president of the revolutionary government at the Tejeros Convention on 22 March 1897. ATLAS treats this as a revolutionary political authority rather than as a fully consolidated national state. It ends this phase immediately before the Republic of Biak-na-Bato was constituted on 2 November 1897.

sources.title: Emilio Aguinaldo y Famy (1869–1964) — National Historical Commission of the Philippines
sources.citation_text: The NHCP biographical marker records Aguinaldo's election at Tejeros on 22 March 1897, presidency of the Biak-na-Bato Republic from 2 November 1897, establishment of the Dictatorial Government on 24 May 1898, Revolutionary Government on 23 June 1898, presidency of the Philippine Republic from 23 January 1899, and capture on 23 March 1901.

sources.title: Philippine Republic 1898–1901 — National Historical Commission of the Philippines
sources.citation_text: The NHCP historical marker identifies Emilio Aguinaldo as President of the First Philippine Republic and documents its presidential seat during 1898–1899.
